lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately four horizontal rows along the lateral flank, with the highest-intensity blobs positioned posterior to the gill slits and anterior to the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, forming a distinct checkerboard-like coordinate system across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 6-10 small, low-intensity high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily concentrated in the posterior-basal region.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region and the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibit a significantly higher density of smaller, stochastic high-luminance blobs compared to the larger, grid-aligned clusters on the lateral flank.
